newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan must closely watch Tokyo stock prices--EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan must closely watch Tokyo stock prices--EPA.

text.p: Tokyo stock price movements need to be watched closely, Economic Planning Agency Vice Minister Shimpei Nukaya told reporters on Friday.
Asked about the tumble in stock prices, Nukaya said: "We can't say there has been no impact on the sentiment of business leaders. Stock price movements should be watched closely."
The Nikkei 225 fell 770.22 points or 4.26 percent to close at 17,303.65 on Friday, the lowest close since August 1995 and the largest one-day fall in two years.
It brought losses on the Nikkei barometer to 2,057.7 points in the first week of the new year.
